rows.casts-a-creature-card-face-down-as-a-two: Oracle: with X paid, choose a creature card in hand whose mana cost the X mana could pay and cast it face down as a 2/2. Observed: the X choice is posed (X = 4) and taken, with the mana from the pool or from four Mountains, but no creature card is ever offered (Hill Giant, and Grizzly Bears with X = 2, stay in hand). Uncorroborated: XMage and Forge have not been run on this scenario.
